source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 5 (PDF 64-75), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Code Testing and Debugging) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which advanced techniques for testing and debugging Python applications does this chapter teach?
(Yeh chapter Python applications ki testing aur debugging ke liye kaun si advanced techniques sikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter 5 ka learning outcome: unit tests, breakpoints aur watches jaisi advanced techniques se Python applications ki testing aur debugging.

book_ref.quote: Use advanced techniques such as unit tests, breakpoints, and watches

blocks.prompt:
2 The techniques used to measure performance and identify bottlenecks in code are:
(Code ki performance napne aur bottlenecks (rukawat wale hisse) dhoondne ki techniques kaun si hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 5.1: profiling aur optimization ki techniques se performance napi jati hai aur bottlenecks pehchane jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Finally, students will explore profiling and optimization techniques

blocks.prompt:
3 Advanced testing and debugging techniques:
(Advanced testing aur debugging techniques kya karti hain?)

options.text: sirf spelling ki ghaltiyan theek karti hain
code likhne ki zaroorat khatam karti hain
bunyadi ghalti theek karne se aage ja kar program ka miyar yaqeeni banati hain
program ko sust magar mehfooz banati hain

blocks.explanation: Section 5.2: advanced techniques sirf bunyadi ghalti theek karne se aage ja kar program ka miyar yaqeeni banati hain aur chhupe masail dhoondti hain.

book_ref.quote: They go beyond basic error fixing to ensure program quality.

blocks.prompt:
4 Which is a benefit of testing and debugging stated in the chapter?
(Chapter mein testing aur debugging ka kaun sa faida bataya gaya hai?)

options.text: Baad mein testing ki zaroorat khatam kar deti hain.
Program ka size barha deti hain.
Program ko memory istemal karne se rokti hain.
Yeh aane wali maintenance aasan banati hain.

blocks.explanation: Testing aur debugging performance aur user ki tasalli behtar karti hain aur aane wale waqt mein maintenance (dekh bhaal) aasan banati hain.

book_ref.quote: They also make future maintenance easier.

blocks.prompt:
5 The process that locates the cause of errors and fixes them is called:
(Woh amal jo ghaltiyon ki wajah dhoond kar unhein theek karta hai kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Debugging ghaltiyon ki wajah dhoond kar unhein theek karti hai; testing ghaltiyan pakadti hai.

book_ref.quote: Debugging locates the cause of errors and fixes them efficiently.

blocks.prompt:
6 Testing and debugging help to detect and remove errors:
(Testing aur debugging ghaltiyan kab pakad kar door karne mein madad deti hain?)

options.text: sirf users ki shikayat ke baad
kabhi nahin; yeh sirf features dalti hain

blocks.explanation: Testing aur debugging software release hone se pehle ghaltiyan pakad kar door karti hain; baqaida testing achanak nakami se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: They help detect and remove errors before the software is released.

blocks.prompt:
7 After a programmer changes the code, testing helps to:
(Programmer code badle to us ke baad testing kis cheez mein madad deti hai?)

options.text: check karna ke tabdeeliyon se purane features kharab nahin hue

blocks.explanation: Testing yeh bhi check karti hai ke tabdeeliyon se pehle se maujood features kharab na hon.

book_ref.quote: It also helps verify that changes do not break existing features.

blocks.prompt:
8 Testing checks whether an application:
(Testing kya check karti hai?)

options.text: sab se zyada memory leti hai
sab se lamba code rakhti hai

blocks.explanation: Testing check karti hai ke application apni requirements (zarooriyat) poori karti hai aur sab functions sahi nateeja dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Testing checks whether an application meets its requirements.

blocks.prompt:
9 The statement below has a missing comma between its two values. What type of error is it?

print("Total marks" 450)
(Neeche wale statement mein do values ke darmiyan comma ghaib hai. Yeh kis qism ka error hai?

print("Total marks" 450))
blocks.explanation: Jo code Python ke usoolon par na chale (yahan comma ghaib) woh syntax error hai; Python use chalata hi nahin.

book_ref.quote: Syntax errors occur when code does not follow language rules.

blocks.prompt:
10 What is the output of the following code?

length = 5
width = 3
area = length + width
print(area)
(Neeche diye gaye code ka output kya hoga?

length = 5
width = 3
area = length + width
print(area))
blocks.explanation: Program chal kar 8 print karta hai, magar area length * width = 15 hona chahiye: yeh logic error hai (ghalat nateeja, koi error message nahin).

book_ref.quote: Logic errors happen when the program produces incorrect results.

blocks.prompt:
11 A program to find the area of a rectangle runs without any error message but prints a wrong area:

length = 5
width = 3
area = length + width
print(area)

What type of error is this, and what is the correct statement?
(Rectangle ka area nikalne wala program bina error message ke chalta hai magar ghalat area print karta hai:

length = 5
width = 3
area = length + width
print(area)

Yeh kaun sa error hai aur sahi statement kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Code chalta hai magar nateeja ghalat hai, is liye logic error hai; area = length * width se 15 aata hai (durust Figure 5.1 ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Logic errors happen when the program produces incorrect results.

blocks.prompt:
12 What happens when this program runs?

marks = 450
students = 0
print(marks / students)
(Yeh program chalne par kya hota hai?

marks = 450
students = 0
print(marks / students))

options.text: Chalne se pehle syntax error aata hai.
Program ZeroDivisionError: division by zero par ruk jata hai (runtime error).

blocks.explanation: Code usoolon ke mutabiq hai, magar chalte waqt zero se taqseem nakam hoti hai: runtime error (ZeroDivisionError: division by zero).

book_ref.quote: Runtime errors appear while the program is running.

blocks.prompt:
13 Besides syntax, logic and runtime errors, which other common bugs does the chapter name?
(Syntax, logic aur runtime errors ke ilawa chapter kaun se aam bugs batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre aam bugs mein data errors aur resource leaks shamil hain; errors pehchanna mustahkam applications ki kunji hai.

book_ref.quote: Other common bugs include data errors and resource leaks.

blocks.prompt:
14 Unit testing helps because it:
(Unit testing kyun mufeed hai?)

options.text: poora program sirf aik baar chalati hai
functions ki zaroorat khatam karti hai
ghaltiyan jaldi pakadti aur debugging aasan banati hai

blocks.explanation: Unit testing program ke alag alag hisson (units) ko test karti hai; yeh ghaltiyan jaldi pakadti aur debugging aasan banati hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps catch errors early and makes debugging easier.

blocks.prompt:
15 A unit test checks whether each component of a program:
(Unit test check karta hai ke program ka har hissa (component):)

options.text: aik saath har computer par chalta hai

blocks.explanation: Unit tests check karte hain ke har component mutawaqqa (expected) output deta hai; saaf aur saade test cases bharosa barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: Unit tests check whether each component produces the expected output.

blocks.prompt:
16 The unittest and pytest modules allow:
(unittest aur pytest modules kya mumkin banate hain?)

options.text: functions aur methods ki automated testing

blocks.explanation: Python ke unittest aur pytest modules functions aur methods ki khud kar (automated) testing mumkin banate hain.

book_ref.quote: These modules allow automated testing of functions and methods.

blocks.prompt:
17 Which testing module is external, that is, not built into Python?
(Kaun sa testing module external hai, yani Python mein pehle se shamil nahin?)
blocks.explanation: unittest Python mein pehle se shamil hai; pytest external module hai jo tests likhna aur chalana aasan banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Pytest is an external module that simplifies writing and running tests.

blocks.prompt:
18 unittest and pytest can test:
(unittest aur pytest kya test kar sakte hain?)

options.text: alag functions, classes ya poore modules

blocks.explanation: Dono modules check karte hain ke code tawaqqo ke mutabiq chalta hai; yeh alag functions, classes ya poore modules test kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: They can test individual functions, classes, or entire modules.

blocks.prompt:
19 A test case defines:
(Test case kya tay karta hai?)

options.text: function ke khaas inputs aur mutawaqqa output

blocks.explanation: Test cases kisi function ke liye khaas inputs aur mutawaqqa output tay karte hain; Python unhein chala kar failures ya errors batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Test cases define specific inputs and the expected output for a function.

blocks.prompt:
20 In pytest, which keyword is used inside a test function to check that the output is correct?
(pytest mein test function ke andar output sahi hone ki jaanch ke liye kaun sa keyword istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: pytest mein tests saade functions hote hain aur output sahi hai ya nahin, yeh assert se check hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The tests are written as simple functions, and assert is used to check if the output is correct.

blocks.prompt:
21 Compared with unittest, pytest:
(unittest ke muqable mein pytest:)

options.text: har test ke liye class mangta hai
Python mein pehle se shamil hai
test case classes ya boilerplate code nahin mangta

blocks.explanation: pytest testing aasan banata hai: is mein unittest ki tarah test case classes ya boilerplate (dohraya jane wala) code nahin chahiye.

book_ref.quote: pytest simplifies testing. It doesn't require test case classes or boilerplate code like unittest.

blocks.prompt:
22 How are the pytest tests in a file run?
(Kisi file ke pytest tests kaise chalaye jate hain?)

options.text: file ke folder mein command line par pytest chala kar

blocks.explanation: Tests chalane ke liye usi folder mein jahan file hai, command line par pytest chalayein.

book_ref.quote: To run the tests, simply execute pytest in the command line in the directory where the file is located.

blocks.explanation: add(5, 5) 10 deta hai, 25 nahin, is liye test_three ka assert fail hota hai; pytest 1 failed, 3 passed batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Python executes these tests and reports failures or errors.

options.text: test_add fail hota hai, kyunke ab add(2, 3) -1 deta hai

blocks.explanation: Ab add(2, 3) -1 deta hai, is liye assert fail hota hai aur pytest failure batata hai: baar baar testing un tabdeeliyon ko pakadti hai jo purana kaam kharab karein.

book_ref.quote: Repeated testing ensures that changes in code do not break existing functionality.

blocks.prompt:
25 Automated test execution:
(Automated test execution (khud kar test chalana) kya karta hai?)

options.text: har test ko fail karta hai
waqt bachata aur durustagi barhata hai
test cases ki zaroorat khatam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Automated test execution development mein waqt bachata aur durustagi barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Automated test execution saves time and improves accuracy in development.

blocks.prompt:
26 Breakpoints and watches allow a programmer to:
(Breakpoints aur watches programmer ko kya karne dete hain?)

options.text: khaas jagah program rok kar data dekhna

blocks.explanation: Breakpoints aur watches program ko khaas jagah rok kar data dekhne dete hain; yeh debugging tez aur durust banate hain.

book_ref.quote: They allow pausing program execution and examining data at specific points.

blocks.prompt:
27 A breakpoint is:
(Breakpoint kya hai?)

options.text: aik line jo variables delete karti hai
aik nishan jo chuni hui code line par program rok deta hai

blocks.explanation: Breakpoint aik nishan hai jo program ko chuni hui code line par rok deta hai (Figure 5.2: code line par, jaise radius = 5).

book_ref.quote: Breakpoints are markers that pause program execution at a chosen line of code.

blocks.prompt:
28 In PyCharm, a breakpoint is set by:
(PyCharm mein breakpoint kaise lagaya jata hai?)

options.text: har variable ki watch laga kar
code ke saath margin mein line number par click kar ke

blocks.explanation: PyCharm mein code ke saath line number (margin) par click kar ke breakpoint lagaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In PyCharm, you can set breakpoints by clicking the line number next to the code (in the margin).

blocks.prompt:
29 When the program reaches a breakpoint:
(Jab program breakpoint par pohanchta hai to kya hota hai?)

options.text: program pehli line se dobara shuru hota hai
sab variables zero ho jate hain
program ruk jata hai aur maujooda halat dekhi ja sakti hai

blocks.explanation: Breakpoint par pohanch kar program ruk jata hai aur maujooda halat (state) dekhi ja sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Breakpoints help focus on specific sections of code without running the entire program.

blocks.prompt:
30 Watch expressions:
(Watch expressions kya karti hain?)

options.text: variables ki values dekhti aur badalne par khud update hoti hain
program ko aik line par rokti hain
data database mein save karti hain
har function ki raftar napti hain

blocks.explanation: Watch expressions program chalte waqt variables ki values dekhti rehti hain aur value badalne par khud update hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: They update automatically when variable values change.

blocks.prompt:
31 In the chapter's calculate_area example, a watch on radius shows its value changing:
(Chapter ki calculate_area misal mein radius par lagi watch us ki value kaise badalti dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: main() pehle radius 5 aur phir radius 10 se calculate_area bulata hai, is liye watch radius ko 5 se 10 hota dikhati hai.

book_ref.quote: Example: You can add a watch for radius and see its value change from 5 to 10 as the program progresses.

blocks.prompt:
32 Which debugging command goes inside a function to see how it works?
(Debugging ki kaun si command function ke andar ja kar dikhati hai ke woh kaise kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Step Into function ke andar (misal mein calculate_area) ja kar dikhata hai ke woh kaise kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Step Into: Go inside a function to see how it's working (calculate_area in the example).

blocks.prompt:
33 Step Over:
(Step Over kya karta hai?)

options.text: line ko chalaye baghair chhod deta hai
maujooda line chala kar agli line par jata hai, function ke andar nahin jata

blocks.explanation: Step Over maujooda line chala kar agli line par jata hai aur kisi function ke andar nahin jata; line phir bhi chalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Step Over: Execute the current line and move to the next one without going inside any functions.

blocks.prompt:
34 The Continue command in the debugger:
(Debugger ki Continue command kya karti hai?)

options.text: maujooda function ke andar jata hai
program hamesha ke liye rok deta hai
agle breakpoint tak program chalata hai

blocks.explanation: Continue program ko agle breakpoint tak chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: Continue: Continue the execution until the next breakpoint.

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the output of the following code?

def calculate_area(radius):
    area = 3.14 * radius ** 2
    return area

def main():
    radius = 2
    print("Area of circle:", calculate_area(radius))
    radius = 4
    print("Area of circle:", calculate_area(radius))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
(Neeche diye gaye code ka output kya hoga?

def calculate_area(radius):
    area = 3.14 * radius ** 2
    return area

def main():
    radius = 2
    print("Area of circle:", calculate_area(radius))
    radius = 4
    print("Area of circle:", calculate_area(radius))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main())

options.text:
Area of circle: 12.56
Area of circle: 25.12

Area of circle: 12.56
Area of circle: 50.24

Area of circle: 6.28
Area of circle: 12.56

blocks.explanation: calculate_area 3.14 * radius ** 2 deta hai: 3.14 x 4 aur 3.14 x 16. Kitab mein radius 5 aur 10 hain; yahan 2 aur 4.

book_ref.quote: The main() function tests the area calculation twice by using two different radius values: 5 and 10.

blocks.prompt:
36 Step-by-step debugging executes code:
(Step-by-step debugging code ko kaise chalati hai?)

options.text: aik waqt mein aik line ya aik function

blocks.explanation: Step-by-step debugging code ko aik line ya aik function kar ke chalati hai, is se logic samajh aati hai aur ghalti ki jagah milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Step-by-step debugging executes code one line or function at a time.

blocks.prompt:
37 Exception handling allows a program to:
(Exception handling program ko kya karne deti hai?)

options.text: crash hone ki bajaye achanak halat mein tameez se jawab dena

blocks.explanation: Exception handling program ko crash hone se bachati hai aur achanak halat mein tameez se jawab dene deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It prevents the program from crashing and allows it to respond gracefully to unexpected situations.

blocks.prompt:
38 In the chapter's database example, which method saves the correct data and ensures integrity?
(Chapter ki database misal mein kaun sa method sahi data save karta aur integrity (durustagi) yaqeeni banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: commit() sahi data save karta hai (integrity yaqeeni); rollback() error ki surat mein tabdeeliyan mansookh karta hai.

book_ref.quote: commit() → saves correct data (ensures integrity)

blocks.prompt:
39 If an error occurs while inserting data, which call in the example cancels the changes?
(Data dalte waqt error aaye to misal mein kaun si call tabdeeliyan mansookh karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: except block mein connection.rollback() error ki surat mein tabdeeliyan wapas le leta hai.

book_ref.quote: rollback() → cancels changes if error occurs

blocks.prompt:
40 In the database example, the block that safely closes the database whether or not an error occurs is:
(Database misal mein woh block jo error ho ya na ho, database ko mehfooz tareeqe se band karta hai:)
blocks.explanation: finally block har haal mein chalta hai aur database connection ko mehfooz tareeqe se band karta hai.

book_ref.quote: finally → safely closes the database

blocks.prompt:
41 What is the output of the following code?

try:
    age = int("twenty")
    print("Age:", age)
except ValueError:
    print("Invalid input")
finally:
    print("Done")
(Neeche diye gaye code ka output kya hoga?

try:
    age = int("twenty")
    print("Age:", age)
except ValueError:
    print("Invalid input")
finally:
    print("Done"))
blocks.explanation: int("twenty") ValueError deta hai, is liye "Age:" print nahin hota; except block Invalid input aur finally hamesha Done print karta hai.

book_ref.quote: try-except → handles errors and prevents crashes

blocks.prompt:
42 What is the output of the following code?

try:
    print(12 / 4)
except ZeroDivisionError:
    print("Cannot divide by zero")
finally:
    print("End")
(Neeche diye gaye code ka output kya hoga?

try:
    print(12 / 4)
except ZeroDivisionError:
    print("Cannot divide by zero")
finally:
    print("End"))
blocks.explanation: Koi exception nahin aati, is liye except block nahin chalta; / se 3.0 aata hai aur finally phir bhi End print karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Python provides built-in tools to catch and handle exceptions efficiently.

options.text:
3.0
Not a number
Zero not allowed

3.0
Zero not allowed
Not a number

3
Zero not allowed
Not a number

blocks.explanation: 24 / 8 = 3.0; int('0') 0 deta hai to ZeroDivisionError par Zero not allowed; int('abc') ValueError deta hai, Not a number. Har qism ka apna jawab hai.

book_ref.quote: Each exception type can be handled with a specific response.

blocks.explanation: Tuple wala aik except clause ValueError aur ZeroDivisionError dono pakadta hai: 10 / 5 = 2.0, phir do errors.

book_ref.quote: Python allows catching multiple exceptions in one try–except block.

blocks.prompt:
45 Handling each exception type with its own response:
(Har exception ki qism ko apne jawab ke saath sambhalna:)

options.text: program ko jaldi crash karta hai
try ki zaroorat khatam karta hai
achanak crash rokta aur sahi error recovery yaqeeni banata hai
runtime errors ko syntax errors banata hai

blocks.explanation: Kai qism ki exceptions sambhalna achanak crash rokta, sahi recovery yaqeeni banata aur program ki mazbooti aur control barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: This approach prevents unexpected crashes and ensures proper error recovery.

blocks.prompt:
46 Profiling measures:
(Profiling kya napti hai?)

options.text: code ka har hissa kitna waqt aur resources leta hai

blocks.explanation: Profiling napti hai ke code ka har hissa kitna waqt aur resources leta hai; optimization sust hisson ko tez banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Profiling measures how much time and resources each part of the code uses.

blocks.prompt:
47 Optimization focuses on:
(Optimization kis par tawajjo deti hai?)

options.text: sust ya bhari hisson ko tez banana

blocks.explanation: Optimization program ke sust ya zyada resources lene wale hisson ko tez banane par tawajjo deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Optimization focuses on making slow or resource-heavy parts faster.

blocks.explanation: Bahar wale loop ki 300 baar mein se har baar andar wala loop 400 baar chalta hai: 300 x 400 = 120000 (kitab ka 10000 x 10000 loop 100,000,000 deta hai).

book_ref.quote: For every single iteration of the outer loop, the inner loop also runs 10,000 times.

blocks.prompt:
49 A nested loop whose inner statement runs one hundred million times and makes the program very slow is called a:
(Woh nested loop jis ka andar wala statement das crore baar chale aur program bohat sust ho jaye kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Code ka aisa sust hissa performance bottleneck kehlata hai; profiling tools ise dhoondne mein madad dete hain taake optimise ho sake.

book_ref.quote: Such a part of the code is called a performance bottleneck.

blocks.prompt:
50 Why should profiling be done regularly?
(Profiling baqaidagi se kyun karni chahiye?)

options.text: taake tests ki zaroorat na rahe
taake code barhne ke saath bhi efficient rahe

blocks.explanation: Baqaida profiling yaqeeni banati hai ke code barhne ke saath bhi efficient rahe.

book_ref.quote: Regular profiling ensures that code remains efficient as it grows.

blocks.prompt:
51 Which Python modules are named in the chapter for measuring performance?
(Chapter mein performance napne ke liye Python ke kaun se modules bataye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Python cProfile aur timeit jaise modules deta hai jo execution time napte aur sust hisse dhoondte hain.

book_ref.quote: Python provides modules like cProfile and timeit for this purpose.

blocks.prompt:
52 Profiling tools track the ______ of different functions in a program.
(Profiling tools program ke mukhtalif functions ka ______ track karte hain.)

options.text: execution time aur memory ka istemal

blocks.explanation: Profiling tools functions ka execution time aur memory ka istemal track karte hain aur batate hain ke kaun se hisse sust ya bhari hain.

book_ref.quote: Profiling tools track the execution time and memory usage of different functions in a program.

blocks.prompt:
53 Measuring performance first helps the programmer to:
(Pehle performance napne se programmer ko kya madad milti hai?)

options.text: optimization ke liye hisson ki tarjeeh tay karna

blocks.explanation: Performance napne se pata chalta hai ke pehle kis hisse ko optimise karna hai.

book_ref.quote: Measuring performance helps prioritize areas for optimization.

blocks.prompt:
54 Which of these is a column heading in the profiling output of Figure 5.3?
(In mein se kaun sa Figure 5.3 ke profiling output ka column heading hai?)
blocks.explanation: Figure 5.3 (durust): headings Function, Call Count, Time, Cumulative Time aur Description hain.

book_ref.quote: the correct headings are Function, Call Count, Time, Cumulative Time and Description

blocks.prompt:
55 Performance bottlenecks are located with the help of:
(Performance bottlenecks kis ki madad se dhoonde jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Performance bottlenecks code ke woh hisse hain jo program sust karte hain; profiling reports unhein dhoondne mein madad deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Performance bottlenecks are sections of code that slow down the program.

blocks.prompt:
56 Which of the following is NOT one of the optimization techniques named in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun si chapter mein batayi gayi optimization technique NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Optimization techniques: algorithms behtar karna, ghair zaroori operations kam karna, efficient data structures istemal karna; extra nested loops program sust karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Optimization techniques include improving algorithms, reducing unnecessary operations, or using efficient data structures.

blocks.prompt:
57 In the chapter's example, why is fast_sum() faster than slow_sum()?
(Chapter ki misal mein fast_sum() slow_sum() se tez kyun hai?)

options.text: Yeh built-in sum() istemal karta hai jo pehle se optimised hai.
Yeh loop mein aik aik number jodta hai.
Yeh aadhi list chhod deta hai.

blocks.explanation: slow_sum() loop mein aik aik number jodta hai; fast_sum() Python ka pehle se optimised sum() istemal karta hai. Dono ka nateeja aik hai.

book_ref.quote: fast_sum() is faster because it uses Python's built-in sum() function, which is already optimised.

blocks.prompt:
58 In a profiling report, the function that takes more execution time is called the:
(Profiling report mein woh function jo zyada execution time le kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo function zyada execution time le woh bottleneck kehlata hai; misal mein slow_sum() bottleneck hai.

book_ref.quote: The function taking more execution time is called the bottleneck.

blocks.prompt:
59 Which module in the example compares the execution time of slow and fast code?
(Misal mein kaun sa module sust aur tez code ka execution time compare karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: cProfile har function ke waqt ki profiling report banata hai; timeit sust aur tez code ka execution time compare karta hai.

book_ref.quote: timeit helps compare the execution time of slow and fast code.
